note: Research cards. A field is shown in the dashboard only after a team member has checked it against the listed source and set reviewed to true. Empty fields are shown as 'not recorded in the sources we used'.

sources_used.challenge: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, Flame in Freefall challenge description
sources_used.table: PSI test table of the investigation (values in data/experiments.csv)

PSI-159.objective: Cool flames of gaseous fuels at the highest oxygen levels tested in PSI: the chamber held nitrogen and a flammable gas such as propane, while an oxygen-nitrogen mixture flowed from a spherical burner and formed an inside-out flame.
PSI-159.sample_or_burner: Spherical burner; ethane, propane and butane, pure or diluted.

PSI-69.objective: Fire suppression: droplet flames of liquid fuel were extinguished by diluting the chamber atmosphere with carbon dioxide and helium.
PSI-69.sample_or_burner: Single droplets of heptane and methanol in the Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus.

PSI-26.objective: Flammability of solid materials such as fabrics and plastics in microgravity, in the fan-driven flow duct built for SPICE inside the Microgravity Science Glovebox.
PSI-26.sample_or_burner: PMMA spheres, SIBAL cotton-fiberglass fabric, Nomex, paraffin wax slabs and candles.

PSI-10.sample_or_burner: Spherical burner in the ACME hardware; ethylene and propane in normal and inverse flames.

PSI-39.sample_or_burner: Single droplets of n-dodecane and dodecane/iso-dodecane mixtures in the Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus.

PSI-25.objective: Flammability of solid materials such as fabrics and plastics in microgravity (second series), in the same glovebox flow duct.
PSI-25.sample_or_burner: PMMA films and slabs of several thicknesses, SIBAL fabric and other solid samples.

PSI-68.sample_or_burner: Droplets of single fuels and mixtures (heptane, decane, ethanol, n-octane, iso-octane, propanol-glycerol) in the Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus.

PSI-100.objective: Spacecraft fire safety demonstration: flammability of solid materials at spacecraft scale.
PSI-100.sample_or_burner: SIBAL fabric in an enclosure inside a Cygnus cargo vehicle.

PSI-98.objective: Spacecraft fire safety demonstration: flammability of solid materials at spacecraft scale.
PSI-98.sample_or_burner: SIBAL fabric sheet, 94 cm wide, 40.6 cm long and 0.37 cm thick, in an enclosure inside a Cygnus cargo vehicle.

PSI-99.objective: Spacecraft fire safety demonstration: flammability of solid materials at spacecraft scale.
PSI-99.sample_or_burner: Samples of SIBAL fabric, PMMA, PMMA with Nomex and silicone in an enclosure inside a Cygnus cargo vehicle.

PSI-20.objective: Materials flammability in still atmospheres as a function of material properties, studied by burning gaseous fuels.
PSI-20.sample_or_burner: Gas burners of 25 mm and 50 mm; ethylene and methane.

PSI-107.objective: Smoke point of gas-jet flames in a co-flowing air stream, in the fan-driven flow duct inside the Microgravity Science Glovebox.
PSI-107.sample_or_burner: Gas-jet nozzles of 0.4064, 0.762 and 1.6002 mm; ethylene, propane, methane and propylene.

PSI-22.objective: Partial gravity was mimicked through the effect of an electric field on the ions that naturally occur in flames.

PSI-101.objective: Fire detection in microgravity: smoke and aerosol measurements.

PSI-102.objective: Fire detection in microgravity: smoke and aerosol measurements.

PSI-47.objective: One of the instruments used for smoke detection in SAME and SAME-R was used here to detect dust.

PSI-106.sample_or_burner: Fan-driven flow duct built for SPICE, inside the Microgravity Science Glovebox.
